fire: We waited a long time for the bus to arrive.
My grandmother was born in Hong Kong in 1950.
She hummed a quiet song while cooking dinner.
The wind was very strong near the coast.
He took the wrong turn at the second bridge.
The bridge across the Mekong was crowded.
There was a gong at the entrance of the temple.
We stayed in Hong Kong for a long week.
quiet: We waited a short time for the bus to arrive.
My grandmother was born in Lisbon in 1950.
She hummed a quiet tune while cooking dinner.
The wind was very cold near the coast.
He took the left turn at the second bridge.
The bridge across the Danube was crowded.
There was a bell at the entrance of the temple.
We stayed in Paris for a whole week.
